test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fff0cee6f0908ab39c5eb9a158988d64c136086a4f25417fe4e1d5b4a0072574.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) First box alternate series : 

 
• Alternately top left corner element, center element and top right corner element shifts in anti-clockwise direction. 
 
• Alternately last two elements from bottom left shifts to the opposite side i.e to the bottom right.
 
• Alternately last two elements from bottom right shifts to the opposite side diagonally i.e to the bottom left.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3ecdad1091d54818bff11f757a4a363acd498624db91f5fbd95154b134c8531.png] 

2) Second box alternate series :

 
• Alternately top left corner element and bottom right corner shifts one step in anti-clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately center left and center right elements shifts to bottom right corner and top left corner position respectively.
 
• Alternately top right corner element, center element and bottom left corner element shifts in anti-clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af9aa7e86afde2d5738eb37489b57a236748d8cde266e7250758b5581e42995e.png] 

The final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54ad2ce0be46314d58a7f875971ded35b4311d02ff90d3f819ce4be786207fcc.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (2)’ is the correct answer.
